guia.what: A text link with the system’s styles—an `<a class="ts link" href>`; an action that looks like a link is a `<button type="button" class="ts link">`. It has variants and a disabled state; external links carry `target="_blank"` and `rel="noopener noreferrer"`.
whenUse: Navigating to another page or to another point in the content.
The link sits inside text and needs to read as text.
You’re pointing outside the site. `target="_blank"` with `rel="noopener noreferrer"` opens it in a new tab without handing control to that page.
whenAvoid: It’s an action that changes something, not a destination → `button`.
It’s a link that needs to look like a button → an `<a class="ts button …">` (see `button`).
dos: Make the text say where it goes: “read the theming guide,” not “click here.”
Mark external links with `target="_blank"` and `rel="noopener noreferrer"` so they don’t catch people off guard.
donts: Don’t use a link to trigger destructive actions.
Don’t leave links that can’t be told apart from plain text.

nucleo: A native `<a>`, or a native `<button>` with the same look when it’s an action.
